headline: Wall Street Analysts Think Solstice Advanced Materials (SOLS) Could Surge 26.16%: Read This Before Placing a Bet
summary: The average of price targets set by Wall Street analysts indicates a potential upside of 26.2% in Solstice Advanced Materials (SOLS). While the effectiveness of this highly sought-after metric is questionable, the positive trend in earnings estimate revisions might translate into an upside in the stock.
